title: Stripeless Data Placement for Erasure-Coded In-Memory Storage
problem: Erasure-coded in-memory storage systems often use striping for data distribution, but striping creates alignment requirements and inefficiencies. Alternative placement strategies could improve performance and flexibility.
motivation: Stripeless data placement for erasure-coded systems improves space efficiency and reduces placement complexity while maintaining fault tolerance.
method: Proposes stripeless data placement strategies for erasure-coded in-memory storage that eliminate alignment overhead and striping-induced inefficiencies.
key_novelty: Stripeless placement techniques for erasure-coded in-memory storage optimizing data distribution without striping overhead.
contributions: Stripeless data placement algorithm for erasure-coded storage
Improved space utilization without striping overhead
Flexible placement strategy supporting diverse data patterns
limitations: Effectiveness depends on erasure code properties and data access patterns; recovery complexity may differ from striped approaches.
